title: Derived coefficient comparison before homology
statement: Let R,A,B,D be commutative rings, A and B R-algebras and D an (A tensor_R B)-algebra. Let F:D(R) to D(B) and L:D(A) to D(D) be universal left derived scalar extension functors with counits delta and epsilon. There is a natural transformation eta: Res_R(-) followed by F to L followed by derived restriction D to A tensor_R B to B. For any A-complex P and any coefficient chain map beta from B tensor_R Res_R(P) to Res_B(D tensor_A P) with generator formula b tensor p maps to the image of (1 tensor b) tensor p, composing the derived input localization factors, delta, and Q(beta) equals eta at Q(P), followed by derived restriction of the epsilon representative at P and the exact restriction localization factor. This is a single comparison in the derived category, independent of homology degree. Derived categories are as in [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

proof.text: Construct the ordinary coefficient natural transformation and descend its localization to the homotopy category. Exact restriction preserves the universal scalar-extension derived pair, by the K-flat criterion.

Compose the input localization factor and delta with the ordinary coefficient transformation. Apply leftDerivedLift for the restricted L pair to obtain eta. leftDerived_fac_app gives its counit compatibility. Tensor induction identifies every beta satisfying the generator formula with the constructed coefficient map. Expand the homotopy/localization factorization isomorphisms to obtain exactly the displayed equation.

theorem exists_baseTensorDerivedChainComparison

    (δ : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ F ⟶

        DerivedCategory.Qh)
    (hF : F.IsLeftDerivedFunctor δ (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ)))
    (L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} D))
    (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L ⟶
      (extendScalars.{u, u, u} ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D).comp
        (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
    (hL : L.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ))) :
    ∃ η : (restrictScalars.{u} (algebraMap R A)).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ F ⟶
        L ⋙ (restrictScalars.{u} (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D) ⋙
          restrictScalars.{u} Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom).mapDerivedCategory,
      ∀ (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
        (β : ((extendScalars.{u, u, u} (algebraMap R B)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj

          ((restrictScalars.{u} (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D) ⋙
            restrictScalars.{u} Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.up ℤ)).obj
            (((extendScalars.{u, u, u} ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D).comp
              (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)),
        (∀ (j : ℤ) (b : B) (p : P.X j),
          β.f j (b ⊗ₜ[R, algebraMap R B] p) =
            (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight b) ⊗ₜ[A,
              (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D).comp (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B))] p)) →
        F.map (((DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).app _ ≪≫
          (restrictScalars.{u} (algebraMap R A)).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.symm.app P).inv) ≫
          δ.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj
            (((restrictScalars.{u} (algebraMap R A)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)) ≫
          DerivedCategory.Qh.map
            (((extendScalars.{u, u, u} (algebraMap R B)).mapHomotopyCategoryFactors
              (.up ℤ)).hom.app _) ≫
          (DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).hom.app _ ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map β =
        η.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
          (restrictScalars.{u} (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D) ⋙
            restrictScalars.{u} Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom).mapDerivedCategory.map
            (L.map ((DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).inv.app P) ≫
              ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
              DerivedCategory.Qh.map
                (((extendScalars.{u, u, u} ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D).comp
                  (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomotopyCategoryFactors
                    (.up ℤ)).hom.app P) ≫
              (DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).hom.app _) ≫
          (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryFactors
